issues.desc: background.md Key Insights uses the abbreviation "3x2" ("not high-risk 3x2") without expanding it on first mention. A new reader cannot infer whether it means 3 rounds x 2 hosts, 3 reviewers x 2 passes, or something else. The negation context ("not 3x2") makes the story scope clear regardless, so this is advisory only.
